fabricationFlags: Currency mislabel: tuition.currency is 'USD' but UWE Bristol bills international students in GBP. Verified official figure for MSci Optometry is GBP 17,000/yr, which matches the catalog's 17000 value -> numbers are GBP amounts incorrectly tagged as USD.
Suspicious price uniformity: vast majority of ~115 programs set to a flat 17000 (with a few 16250/16750/17250/17500/18000), indicating bulk estimation rather than per-course verification.
programUrl for nearly all programs points to aggregator edge.edvoy.com institution page, not to official uwe.ac.uk course pages (only Kaplan-sourced entries like Optometry use courses.uwe.ac.uk).
All programs flagged verified:true source:'edvoy' while many carry verifiedBySite:false -> 'verified' label not backed by official-site confirmation.

evidence: Official site uwe.ac.uk confirmed live. Campuses Frenchay/Glenside/City confirmed via uwe.ac.uk/life/accommodation.
